title: How to Hire a Ghostwriter for Your Book
h1: How to hire a ghostwriter for your book
description: Hire a book ghostwriter: define the book, share your material, agree process, voice, rights and credit, schedule, payment and what to ask first.
intro: A ghostwriter writes a book that is published under your name, using your ideas, stories and voice. People hire one when they have valuable experience but not the time or writing skill to produce a whole book. The result depends on how well you share your thinking and how clearly you agree on the process, rights and credit. This article explains how to prepare and what to ask before you hire.

faq.a: Yes, it is a long-standing practice. Be clear in your contract about credit and about any statements the book makes in your name.
Normally you should. Make sure the contract states that all rights transfer to you when you pay.

faq.q: How long does a book take?
faq.a: It depends on length and how quickly you provide material and feedback. Ask for a schedule with milestones.

faq.q: What do I need to provide?
faq.a: Your ideas, stories, outline, notes, recordings and examples of writing you like, plus time for interviews.
A good ghostwriter studies how you speak and write, then you review chapters and correct anything that does not sound like you.
